visual_text: Of 100 care home residents in England and Wales in 2009, about 74 were alive a year later
About 26 died within the year. A group figure doesn't predict one person. Ask the doctor: what do you expect for this person?
England and Wales, 2009. Residents aged 65 to 104 already living in a care home (9,772 people), followed for one year.
Shah et al, Age and Ageing 2013
alt_text: Grid of 100 person icons: 74 solid teal marked alive a year later, 26 hatched orange marked died within a year. England and Wales, 2009, 9,772 care home residents aged 65 to 104. Text says a group figure does not predict one person and suggests asking the doctor.
design_instructions: Single card. 10x10 person icons drawn in custom SVG: 74 solid teal, 26 orange hatched (last 2.6 rows). Direct labels beside grid. Body text and setting note. Claim C16-12-a (26.2%, n=9,772).
